### 13.4 轴向恢复规则

- z<15.761 cm：Pyrex 坐标为普通水导向管。
- 15.761–376.441 cm：使用毒物截面。

|---|---:|
| 材料 | SS304 |
| 外半径 | 0.538 cm |
| 高度 | 11.0 cm |
| 底/顶 | 383.310 / 394.310 cm |

findings.message: The facts patch includes detailed properties for RCCA materials (e.g., AIC density 10.2 g/cc, AIC radius 0-0.382 cm) and attributes them to sections §15.1-15.6. However, the provided source excerpt explicitly ends at §13.4. These specific dimensional and material values cannot be verified against the supplied evidence.
